input_messages.content: Hi! I need some help with my recent orders and account details. I just moved to a new house on Elm Avenue here in Houston, and I noticed that one of my orders was sent to my old address. I’d like to update the shipping address for that order to my new place, and also set my new home as my default address on my account. Can you help me with that?
Sure, my email is sophia.martin4832@example.com. Let me know if you need anything else to verify my account.

Actually, I’d prefer not to share my address directly. Since both my old and new homes are on Elm Avenue and my recent orders should have the addresses, could you please look up the new address from my latest order? That way, you can update the other order and my default address to match the most recent one on file. Is that possible?

Yes, please go ahead and update both the order and my default address to the new one.

Also, I wanted to ask about exchanging the tablet I just bought. Because of all the moving expenses, I’d like to swap it for the cheapest tablet you have available. Can you help me with that as well?
Yes, please exchange my current tablet for the 10-inch, 64GB, silver one, and refund the difference to my card. Thank you for your help!
In that case, please modify my order to the 10-inch, 64GB, silver tablet instead of the one I originally chose. That would be perfect. Let me know if you need anything else from me!
Yes, please go ahead and make that change. That’s the only modification I need for this order. Thanks again for your help!

That’s great, thank you so much for your help! I don’t need anything else right now. Have a wonderful day! 

###STOP###
